senses.gloss: (also חיור יין) pr. n. pl. Ḥivvaryayin, Ḥivv’rayin.—חֲמַר ח׳ name of a wine of inferior quality and color, cmp. בָּרַק.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 97b:10">B. Bath. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>חמר חיוריין מהו</he> (Ms. H. <he>חיור יין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) how about the use of Ḥ. wine for religious purposes?—

<cite ref="Keritot 6a:44">Kerith. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>חמר חיור יין עתיק</he> old Ḥ. wine (used as a substitute of caper wine for soaking onycha); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:5:2">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite> <cite ref="H00688"><he>חיורין</he></cite>.
